company.shortDescription: Ohm's is a new car battery which features a low weight, long lifetime, cold weather performance, and an environmentally friendly design.
company.description: Ohm is smart enough to keep you from accidentally draining your battery if you forget to turn your lights off. It will automatically turn itself off when it gets critically low, and then switch itself back on when you go to start your car. No more getting stranded with a dead battery.

productsAndServices.description: A lightweight car battery that combines supercapacitors and LiFePO4 cells to provide starting power, long life, and cold weather performance without lead or acid.
